utterance: `shop-vpc` (10.40.0.0/16) is the storefront's network, and the subnets marked as the storefront's front segments are where anything fronting storefront traffic sits. Nothing fronts its traffic yet: the network holds no load balancer and no target group. Stand up the storefront's web front end: launch a t3.micro web server into the VPC, and put an internal network load balancer across the storefront's front segments in front of it, listening on TCP 80 and forwarding to a target group in `shop-vpc` on TCP 80 that has the storefront's web servers registered on port 80. Give every resource you create a Name tag.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: shop-vpc runs a new t3.micro web server of the agent's own and an internal network load balancer that spans every segment of shop-vpc marked as the storefront's front tier, listening on TCP 80 and forwarding to a target group in shop-vpc on TCP 80 that holds every storefront web server in service — the agent's own included — registered on port 80, with a Name tag on everything created
